fixed_xyz_review.rationale: Both carboxyl termini have dissociated as free CO₂ in the optimized coordinates. Each remaining pyridylselenium–CH₂ fragment is neutral with an odd electron count; Retain Se–C, Place one radical on each terminal CH₂. Two Cl⁻ balance Pd(II). The electrons can delocalize between Se and carbon. The local radical symbols do not determine total spin

fixed_xyz_review.electronic_state_evidence: Original coordinates fixed, PBE/def2-SVP gives E(UKS triplet) − E(RKS closed-shell singlet) = -4.91 kcal/mol. The triplet lies +1.19 kcal/mol above the broken-symmetry Ms=0 solution; The latter is not a pure spin eigenstate. The total spin also depends on spin coupling, the functional and other accessible states; Original input multiplicity 1 recorded separately
